summary: # ** Review Petition No. 20/RP/2018 along with I.A. Nos. 46/IA/2019, 48/IA/2019 and 49/IA/2019 and Review Petition No.3/RP/2019 ** Petition of review and modification of the order dated 22.2.2018 passed in Petition No. 13/TT/2017 under section 94(1)(f) of the Electricity Act, 2003. Sanyal, Advocate, DIL Shri Ashwin Ramathan, Advocate, KSKMPL Ms. Swapna Seshadri, Advocate, KSKMPL Shri Anmol Nair, Advocate, KSKMPL Shri Harsh Anand, Advocate, TRN Shri Gaurav Majumdar, Advocate, TRN Shri M.G. Ramachandran, Sr. Advocate, RRVPNL and NPCL Shri Shubham Arya, Advocate, RRVPNL and NPCL Ms. Tanya, Advocate, RRVPNL and NPCL Shri R.B. Sharma, Advocate, BRPL and BYPL Shri Mohit Mudgil, Advocate, BRPL and BYPL Shri Sekhar Saklani, BYPL Shri Matrugupta Mishra, Advocate, MCCPL Shri Shourya Malhotra, Advocate, MCCPL| Learned counsel for the Review Petitioner submitted that Review Petition Nos. 20/RP/2018 and 3/RP/2019 emanate out of the order dated 22.2.2018 in Petition No.13/TT/2017 and order dated 6.11.2018 in Petition No.205/TT/2017 wherein the Commission determined the tariff of Champa-Kurukshetra HVDC Pole-I and Pole-II respectively. She further submitted that Petition No. 142/MP/2019 has been filed by KSK Mahanadi Power Limited wherein the methodology followed by the Review Order in Petition No. 20/RP/2018 (with 46/IA/2019 and 48/IA/2019) and Petition No. 3/RP/2019 Page **10** of 13 Petitioner for billing of Pole-I and Pole-II of Champa-Kurukshetra corridor has been sought to be modified. 2. Learned counsel for the Review Petitioner submitted that in compliance of Commission’s direction, they have served copies on all the respondents who were parties in Review Petition No. 20/RP/2018. 3. Learned counsel further submitted that though the Commission vide its order dated 9.5.2019 has admitted Review Petition No. 3/RP/2019 and directed to issue notice to the respondents but the respondents are yet to be served. She further submitted that any order passed by the Commission in Review Petition No. 20/RP/2019 will apply to Review Petition No. 3/RP/2019 as well. She submitted that receivables of the Review Petitioner in the case of Champa-Kurukshetra HVDC Pole-I and Pole-II are mounting as the respondents are being billed provisionally which in turn is resulting in underrecovery and requested for early hearing of Review Petition Nos. 20/RP/2018 and 3/RP/2019. Order in Petition No. 20/RP/2018 (with 46/IA/2019 and 48/IA/2019) and Petition No. 3/RP/2019 Commission’s order dated 13.5.2019 in Review Petition No. 20/RP/2018 regarding billing may also be made applicable in its case. 6. We have considered the submissions of MB Power (MP) Ltd. It is observed that MB Power (MP) Ltd. has filed an application for impleadment, besides other prayers, on 2.5.2019 and the same was mentioned during the hearing on 2.5.2019. The said application was under scrutiny and it was not registered. Hence, in order dated 13.5.2019, it was inadvertently observed that MB Power (MP) Ltd. did not file the application for impleadment. The Interlocutory Application No.48/IA/2019 filed by MB Power (MP) Ltd. for impleadment is allowed. Further, the relief granted to TRN Energy Ltd. in order dated 13.5.2019 is also extended to MB Power (MP) Ltd. 8. The Commission’s order dated 13.5.2019 regarding billing shall be applicable to all the generators, IPPs and beneficiaries. This billing and payment mechanism will continue till the outcome of the present Review Petitions. Order in Petition No. 20/RP/2018 (with 46/IA/2019 and 48/IA/2019) and Petition No. 3/RP/2019 9. We direct the Review Petitioner to serve all the respondents in Review Petition No. 3/RP/2019 as expeditiously as possible and the parties are directed to complete the pleadings by 29.5.2019. 10. The e-filing window of the Commission in Review Petition Nos. 20/RP/2018 and 3/RP/2019 shall remain open till 6.00 p.m. on 29.5.2019. The timeline indicated by the Commission vide its order dated 9.5.2019 in Review Petition No.3/RP/2019 for completion of pleadings stand modified accordingly. The parties are directed to comply with the directions within the specified timeline and no extension of time shall be granted. 11. Petition Nos. 20/RP/2018 and 3/RP/2019 be listed for hearing on 30.5.2019 at 3.00 p.m. Order in Petition No. 20/RP/2018 (with 46/IA/2019 and 48/IA/2019) and Petition No. 3/RP/2019
